{{Quote|I have never seen this kind of Vong tech before! I fear the countdown cannot be stopped&mdash;but I will try!|Fionah Ti|<ref name="Legacy 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>}}
'''Fionah Ti''', the non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of two [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]], learned other skills from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]], including basic [[Shaper caste|Shaper]] [[Shaping protocol|skills]]. After the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] journeyed to [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] on a mission to discover proof that the [[Ossus Project]] had not been compromised by the Yuuzhan Vong. Ti remained on Wayland and restored some of the subjects that were mutated by [[Zenoc Quah]], the shaper and saboteur of the Ossus Project.

In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Maladi]] set a [[Wayland trap|trap]] for the ex-Jedi [[Cade Skywalker]] that used a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Ti to lure him to Wayland. He came with [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]], and the latter was captured and tortured in an attempt to manipulate Skywalker towards the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. After rescuing the unconscious Syn, Ti teamed up with him to help rescue his friends; they were also joined by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]]. The trio successfully fought Quah's mutated [[Vongspawn]] but discovered Maladi had set a self-destruct mechanism on her laboratory, which Ti attempted but failed to disarm. Fionah Ti fled the explosion with Sazen and Syn while Skywalker [[Dark transfer|healed]] Blue with the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Here on Wayland the curse began so here I started.|Fionah Ti, describing the "mission" to Jariah Syn|<ref name="Legacy 44" />}}
Fionah Ti was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], the daughter of the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assigned to [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] at some point before the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. Born without [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], Ti was nevertheless taught fighting skills by both [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], as well as basic [[Shaper caste|Shaper]] [[Shaping protocol|skills]] by the latter.<ref name="Legacy 44" />

When the Sith-Imperial War commenced, Zonama Sekot fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and its inhabitants lost contact with the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Jedi]]; they only later learned about the [[Massacre at Ossus|massacre]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Ti and others were given a mission to uncover proof that the [[Ossus Project]] was sabotaged. Since the [[Vongspawn virus]] began on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], Ti traveled there and discovered that someone, the Yuuzhan Vong saboteur [[Zenoc Quah]], had continued experimenting with [[Vongspawn]] mutations. In [[Time/Legends|time]], Ti discovered a way to restore some of the mutated subjects to their original form.<ref name="Legacy 44" />

===Marked for a trap===
{{Quote|I am impressed! You know not only the language of the Yuuzhan Vong, but the ways of the warrior. What is your name?|Fionah Ti, after Jariah Syn claimed an amphistaff|<ref name="Legacy 44" />}}
In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Maladi]] set a [[Wayland trap|trap]] for the former Jedi [[Cade Skywalker]] and paid the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Rav]] one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to give up Skywalker.<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref> After tracking Skywalker to [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], the pirate claimed to have a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] job for one million credits to deal with a "local pest"<ref name="Legacy 43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref>&mdash;in actuality, Fionah Ti&mdash;<ref name="Legacy 44" /> who was infering with the business of some associates on Wayland.<ref name="Legacy 43" /> Skywalker, his friend [[Jariah Syn]], and his lover [[Deliah Blue]] accepted the bounty.<ref name="Legacy 44" />

The trio was attacked and left unconscious by the near-[[Death/Legends|fatal]] screams of mutated Vongspawn. Blue was carried off to a [[Wayland Yuuzhan Vong laboratory|laboratory]] before Ti could help her and Skywalker left only [[Blood/Legends|blood]] behind in the time it took to bring Syn to Ti's ship. When he awakened, Syn tried to attack Ti without waiting for explanations. After briefly describing the events, Ti performed a shoulder throw on Syn, then provided further details of what had transpired while he was unconscious. When he mentioned that he had come with Cade Skywalker, Ti recognized the name, knowing of him and his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Kol Skywalker]]. As Syn grew angry that Rav had set them up, an [[amphistaff]] appeared behind Ti. Speaking in the [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Language/Legends|language]], Syn calmed and claimed the amphistaff for himself with the name [[Heartstriker]]. Ti was impressed and called him a warrior, then offered to work with him to find his friends.<ref name="Legacy 44" />

===To the rescue===
{{Quote|We should work together, Warrior Syn. There is a terrible place not far from here where the mutation experiments are being carried out. I believe your friends were taken there&hellip;|Fionah Ti, to Jariah Syn|<ref name="Legacy 44" />}}
Ti and Syn journeyed to where they both believed his friends were being held. Although Ti was concerned that Blue and Skywalker may be beyond help, Syn insisted they had to try.<ref name="Legacy 45" /> The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]] also arrived on Wayland after having [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] that Skywalker needed him. Sazen was initially skeptical until Syn described Ti as "a friend," which he said was enough. The three then continued onward together to the laboratary.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

As they fought Quah's creations, Syn attacked the Vuuzhan Vong with Heartstriker to protect Ti. When Syn, Sazen, and Ti located Blue, they found that Maladi had tortured and infected her to manipulate Skywalker. Maladi had set a self-destruct mechanism on the laboratory, and despite never seeing the technology before, Ti attempted to disarm it; however, they were all running out of time. While Skywalker remained behind to attempt to [[Dark transfer|heal]] Blue, which Sazen urged him to do using the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] instead of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]], Ti fled from the impending explosion with Syn and Sazen. Afterward, the trio learned that Skywalker had succeeded and the couple had survived.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fionah Ti was first indirectly mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Legacy (2006) 43|issue forty-three]] as the target of a bounty,<ref name="Legacy 43" /> then first appeared in [[Legacy (2006) 44|issue forty-four]].<ref name="Legacy 44" /> Ti's three appearances were written by [[John Ostrander]] and pencilled by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="Legacy 44" /><ref name="Legacy 46" /><ref name="Legacy 45" />
